Skill 2, Whirling Strike, can help you clear the first minion wave quickly to get level 2 before your opponent, giving you an advantage that you can use to win early trades. Teamfights are a struggle for Arthur. You don't have a lot of mobility, so it's difficult for you to get onto the back line with your Ultimate and Skill 1. Always stay close enough to your team so they can back up your engage, and don't chase too far, as you can be kited very easily.

Start trades with Skill 1 for more damage on your auto attacks and other skills
You can auto attack after using Skill 1 to dash anywhere even over walls

In the early game, Devara can use his ranged attacks to punish the enemy when they want to walk up and last-hit minions. Always auto-attack after using a Skill to deal extra magic damage and restore health

## Early Game
Since Dun is a tank, your early game should be focused on full clearing the jungle to quickly reach level 4. Once you have your Ultimate Unruly Blade, you can start looking for ganks with your incredible crowd control. When ganking, use your skills to stun and knockup the enemy, then follow up with your basic attacks.

## Teamfights
Dun's primary goal is to start fights with his Ultimate to close the gap and stun enemy heroes. When possible, try to target the backline, so your team can follow up with their damage. Stay in the front line and protect your carrys when possible. If they get jumped on you can turn around and use your crowd control to peel for them to keep them alive.

## Tips & Tricks
To guarantee the knockup from Skill 1 Wind Slash, use your Ultimate Unruly Blade to stun the enemy first
Dun's Ultimate doesn't need to hit an enemy for you to travel so that you can use it as an escape tool
Use skill 2, Gale's Benediction, at the start of the fight to get a shield and increase your damage with your basic attacks

## Early Game
For the first minion wave, you can use Skill 1 Arcane Assault and aim it so it hits all the minions. If you do this with both your charges, you will proc his passive, allowing you to quickly clear the first wave. You can use this advantage to roam and try to help your other lanes. You can consistently do this throughout the early game and look to roam and snowball the early game.

## Teamfights
Kongming can be very challenging to play in teamfights. He's not your traditional mid lane mage that sits back and uses abilities from range; he wants to get in the face of enemies utilising his passive and burst damage. You want to keep yourself alive and look to cleanup fights when heroes are low on health. If you can use his Ultimate Winning Strategy to finish off heroes, you can use it multiple times in a teamfight. However, one misposition or one wrong dash and you could get caught and one-shot since Kongming is very squishy.

## Tips & Tricks
Position and use Skill 1 where you can hit all 3 orbs to get maximum stacks for his Passive
Never use Kongming's Ultimate at the start of a fight
Use minions and monsters to get stacks for your passive before joining a teamfight

Skill 1 can be used to jump over walls
If Lam is submerged with Skill 1 in a river, the duration never runs out
Lam's Ultimate can be used behind enemies to push them into your team

hokfire_guide.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
At level 1, you want to take Skill 2 and start in the mid lane. With your tankiness, you can walk up and hit all the minions with Skill 2 to help your mid lane clear the wave. After, you want to go to the farm lane to protect your carry. Remember that Skill 1 cooldown can be reset when you hit Skill 2 so you can Skill 1 > Skill 2 > Skill 1 for free damage during the early game.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, you want to be the main initiator. You have great AOE knockups with both Skill 1 and your Ultimate. When using your Ultimate, if the enemies are trying to escape, you can flash at the last second to reposition your knockup to surprise enemies in fights. This initiation alone can win teamfights for your team. You can also combo your knockup with Frigid Charge to stun enemies when they land back from your knockup, making it impossible for them to escape.

## Tips & Tricks
You can flash during the 3rd strike on Lian Po's Ultimate to reposition so you can hit his knockup
Skill 1 can be used to dash over walls
If enemies are within range when charging Skill 2, Skill 1 resets for an extra dash

Start in the mid lane and use Skill 2 to poke the enemy and help your mid laner push the minion wave with your passive. Skill 2 is a strong tool to have early on with its long range and CC potential. ## Early Game
Wang Zhaojun has a pretty solid early game. Her wave clear isn't the best early on, but when you rotate, your crowd control can be clutch in skirmishes. Don't waste Frigid Prison Skill 2 for poke. Instead, keep it for setting up kills and punishing enemies who step too far forward.

## Teamfight
In teamfights, be patient with Frigid Prison Skill 2 and only use it when you can guarantee it hits an enemy. Usually it's good to wait for your team to use their crowd control, then follow up afterwards. Position yourself in the back line and use your Ultimate Winter is Here to protect yourself and zone enemies.

## Tips & Tricks
You can auto-attack whilst standing still to get your enhanced basic attack when you get to lane or at the start of a fight
Use Skill 1 Shattered Ice to slow enemies, making Skill 2 Frigid Prison easier to hit
You can use Skill 1 and Skill 2 to check bushes before enterting them

## Early Game
Wukong has decent early jungle clear speed with his Skill 2 mobility and empowered auto attacks. He also has a lot of burst damage early on, and great crowd control with his Ultimate Golden Cudgel, so you can look for early ganks to try and snowball the early game; however, if you make a mistake and fall behind, it becomes extremely difficult to come back into the game.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, as an assassin, Wukong wants to hide in bushes and engage from unexpected angles. You don't want to be the first one to engage in the front line. You need to completely ignore the tanks and focus on their Marksman or Mage to one-shot them with your burst combo. This is your main goal; failing to do so will lose you the teamfight and potentially the game.

## Tips & Tricks
Always basic attack after using a Skill to deal bonus damage with Wukong's passive
Save Skill 1 for blocking important enemy skills
You can use Skill 2 to bounce off minions or teammates to help escape or catch up to enemies

## Early Game
Use Skill 1 Blossoming Fan to clear the minion wave and poke the enemy at the same time. Keep at maximum range of your skills to avoid taking damage. When you have cleared the mid wave, look to roam and use your crowd control with Skill 2 Honeysweet Breeze to impact other lanes and help them get ahead.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, be patient with Skill 2. Hide in bushes and look to knockup up high-value targets, but be sure to stand behind your frontline so you don't get caught. Always stay at maximum range of your skills. Don't walk up to get in range to use Xiao Xiao's ultimate Meteor Storm. This Ultimate should only be used if enemies can't escape or help with damage when being jumped on by assassins

## Tips & Tricks
Standard Combo Skill 2 > Skill 1
Hide in bushes and use Xiao Xiao's combo before enemies see you
